def multiply_int(x, y):
    """Return the product of x and y without using the multiplication operator."""
    negative = (x < 0) != (y < 0)
    a = abs(x)
    b = abs(y)
    result = 0
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            result += a
        a <<= 1
        b >>= 1
    return -result if negative else result
